entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Human leader of the Valley of Tamingazin on Dominaria, who united the valley and was shot dead on his coronation day.

entities.name: Valley of Tamingazin
entities.description: A valley on Dominaria home to humans, elves and viashino.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the valley lies.

entities.name: Viashino
entities.description: A species of the valley who killed Tagard's wife for trespassing.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: A city ruled by Bey Lisolo that opposed Tagard until subdued.

entities.name: Lisolo
entities.description: Ruler of Berimish whose torc Tagard took; later crowns Tagard.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: A mage of the Institute of Arcane Study who helped Tagard subdue Berimish.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: A neutral institute in the valley.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: The Suderbod Ambassador who saved Tagard from an assassin.

entities.name: Karelon
entities.description: Tagard's general, who opposed including the Viashino.

entities.name: Rael Gar
entities.description: The Garan leader who opposed the Viashino's inclusion.

events.summary: Tagard's wife is killed by viashino, setting him on a campaign to unite the valley.
events.quote: her mother was killed by viashino for trespassing on their territory while collecting fruit

events.summary: Tagard unites humans, elves and Viashino under himself as Bey of the valley, except the Institute and Berimish.
events.quote: He eventually succeeded in uniting humans, elves, and Viashino in a single front

events.summary: With Aligarius Timni's sleep spell, Tagard takes Lisolo's torc in a bloodless coup, controlling Berimish.
events.quote: Tagard took Lisolo’s torc of leadership

events.summary: A Viashino assassin attacks Tagard; Ursal Daleel kills the attacker.
events.quote: Tagard was attacked by a Viashino assassin

events.summary: Karelon and Rael Gar oppose including the Viashino Lisolo on the council.
events.quote: who both opposed the Viashino’s inclusion

events.summary: Tagard is shot dead with two crossbow bolts right after Lisolo crowns him.
events.quote: Tagard was fatally shot through the chest with two crossbow bolts

relations.quote: Tagard Tarngold had a daughter, Tallibeth
Tagard Tarngold was the human leader of the Valley of Tamingazin on Dominaria
Tagard enlisted the help of Aligarius Timni from the Institute
saving Tagard’s life and killing the would-be attacker
